hook.name: HappiUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap V4 hook for Happi v2 graduated memecoin pools that charges a configurable fee on the unspecified leg of every swap via afterSwap return delta. Batches memecoin-denominated fees and converts them to the pool's quote currency via internal swaps, then distributes proceeds among the protocol, creator, and an optional market-maker vault.
